Name: Seasonal Field Kit
Author: AleksSmash2020
Description:
Seasonal Field Kit is a small Stardew Valley Content Patcher pack for players who want outdoor preparation to change with the season. It adds four craftable field meals, each tied to a different seasonal forage recipe and unlock path. The goal is not a large food overhaul; it is a compact rotating loop that gives common seasonal finds a practical reason to come along on a trip.

[b]How it works[/b]

Play through the year normally, gather the forage available in the current season, and use the matching recipe when its seasonal condition is active. Because the recipes rotate with the calendar, the useful preparation for spring is not identical to the one you plan for summer, autumn or winter. The system rewards noticing what the valley is offering rather than stockpiling one universal meal forever.

[b]What is included[/b]

The pack contains four craftable field meals, seasonal recipe and unlock conditions, original pixel-art item sprites, English default text and Russian localization. It does not replace original game files and does not add a new shop, custom DLL or external framework.

[b]Installation and removal[/b]

Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then copy the `SeasonalFieldKit` folder into Stardew Valley's `Mods` directory. Start the game through SMAPI. No existing save conversion is required. To remove it, close the game and take the folder back out of `Mods`.

[b]Credits and disclosure[/b]

This is an original AI-assisted mod project by AleksSmash2020. The item concepts, configuration, localization, sprites and presentation were created specifically for this release; no third-party mod code or assets are bundled.
